findings.title: Every cross-domain edge goes through an allowed gateway
findings.detail: 10 dependencies cross a bounded context. Allowed landing points: aggregator, port.

findings.title: Domain dependency graph has cycles
findings.detail: Strongly-connected components as sanctioned carve-outs are removed in turn.
items: minus wiring + ports + infra entities: 1 SCC(s)

findings.title: No same-level injection
findings.detail: Checked among transaction-script, service, aggregator, mapper, assembler, converter.

findings.title: No upward calls
findings.detail: Layering holds in the direction the rules require.

findings.title: Action reaches Repository directly, skipping Service and Transaction Script
findings.detail: Intended flow is action -> service -> transaction-script -> repository.

findings.title: Service reaches Repository directly, skipping Transaction Script
findings.detail: Intended flow is action -> service -> transaction-script -> repository.

findings.title: app/ and apps/ used interchangeably
findings.detail: Tooling that globs one spelling silently misses the other.

findings.title: 1 files are unreachable from any route or module
findings.detail: Walking imports outward from every HTTP handler and every *.module.ts registration never arrives at these. Likely dead.

findings.title: 3 entity references are implicit
findings.detail: The data model has 6 references between entities; 3 are declared to the ORM and 3 exist only as a bare id column. 3 of them cross a bounded context.

findings.title: Files that change often and are widely depended on
findings.detail: Across 36 commits. Score is commits multiplied by dependents: a file high on both is where a refactor pays for itself, and where a mistake spreads furthest.

findings.title: No files change together without an import edge
findings.detail: Across 36 commits (2 ignored for touching more than 25 files), no pair of files co-changes above 60% without an import edge. The history either agrees with the import graph, or it is too young to disagree yet.

findings.title: Test presence by pattern
findings.detail: Tested / total source files, pattern by pattern. This is presence, not quality — a file with one smoke test counts as tested. 1 of 12 spec files matched no source by name and count as testing nothing.

findings.title: 15 high-risk files have no test
findings.detail: Ranked by commits multiplied by dependents — the same score the hotspots lens uses. A file that changes often, is widely depended on, and is unverified is where a regression is both most likely and most costly.

findings.title: Circular imports between files
findings.detail: Mutually importing files — genuine runtime cycles.

findings.title: 11 configured patterns exist nowhere in the code
findings.detail: Either the architecture document describes shapes that were never built, or the config names patterns this project does not use.
